user.title: What kind of device is it?
user.description: Each HubIR entity is one device in front of one Broadlink remote. Add another for every device you want to control.

climate.title: Add an air conditioner
climate.description: The device code names the file of IR codes to use. Find one in the tables in the documentation, or record your own with the HubIR panel in the sidebar.

data_description.device_code: A number such as 1020. Codes from 90000 up are the ones you recorded yourself.
data_description.controller_data: The remote entity that transmits the codes.
data_description.delay: How long to wait between the codes of a multi-code command.
data_description.temperature_unit: Leave empty to read it from the device file, which is right for almost every device.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Reports the real room temperature, which infrared cannot.
data_description.power_sensor: Optional. Tells the entity whether the device is really on.
data_description.power_sensor_reassert: Only acts when the sensor says off while Home Assistant thinks the unit is running — a dropped IR frame. It never switches the unit off, because a sensor saying on almost always means somebody picked up the real remote. Waits a minute after any command, and gives up after three tries. Needs a sensor that reports more often than once a minute.
data_description.reassert_interval: For a unit that forgets its setpoint after a power blip. Sends nothing while the entity is off.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send a code from a HubIR entity's own device file, named by its path. For the buttons the entity does not model: a menu key, an arrow, an LED toggle. Does not change the entity's state.

command.name: Command
command.description: Path to the code, separated by '/'. For example 'extras/menu', 'presets/turbo', 'sources/HDMI1' or 'cool/low/16'.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How many times to send the code. Useful for a volume ramp.

send_code.name: Send code
send_code.description: Send a raw code through a Broadlink remote, without a HubIR entity. For a code that is not in a device file yet.

remote_entity_id.name: Remote
remote_entity_id.description: The Broadlink remote entity to transmit through.

code.name: Code
code.description: One code, or a list of codes to send in turn. A list is how a two-packet toggle button is stored.

encoding.name: Encoding
encoding.description: How the code is written. Base64 is what the panel records.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds to wait between the codes of a list.
